title: Ordinary tensor target coordinates before the derived stalk presentation
statement: Let R,A,R',A' be commutative rings with the algebra structures and compatible maps of a cartesian spectrum square as in [def-pc-affine-base-change-tilde-coordinates]. Let M be any complex of A-modules, i an integer and p a prime of A'. Put P=tilde M, C=A' tensor_A M, N=tilde C, T=g'^*P, and s the module stalk functor at p. Let rho be the scalar map to the fourth stalk obtained from [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Construct affineTildeHomologyLocalization:H^i(C)_p to H^i(N_p) from exact tilde homology, localization of tilde stalks and [lem-pc-affine-derived-cohomology-presentation]. There exists a chain isomorphism tau:N_p to tensorComplex(p,P) which sends the germ of 1 tensor x to 1 tensor the germ of x in every degree. For every localized cohomology class y, affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso(y) equals affineRepresentativeStalkIso(T).inv applied to homology(tensorStalkIso) applied to homology(tau) applied to affineTildeHomologyLocalization(y). No K-flatness and no base-derived source model are assumed.

proof.text: Construct affineTildeHomologyLocalization from IsLocalizedModule.iso for StructureSheaf.toStalkₗ, followed by the stalk of the exact tilde homology isomorphism and homologyFunctorFactors, and affineRepresentativeStalkIso. This construction is provided explicitly in Lean without a hole.

Construct delta:T isomorphic to N by mapHomologicalComplexCompIso of the chosen tensor-pullback/tilde isomorphism. Set tau to the stalk of delta inverse followed by tensorStalkIso inverse. Apply the tilde unit equation to the canonical section x, then the module stalk germ naturality equation. Apply the pullback-stalk germ equation to the same section and transport its scalar map using the first restriction equation of tensorMap. Cancel the two isomorphisms degreewise to obtain the stated pure-tensor formula. No generation or uniqueness argument is required.

Factor affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso into the localized module isomorphism, the stalk of the exact tilde/derived homology isomorphism, and the stalk of derived homology of delta inverse. Evaluate its three isomorphisms using the proved generic mapIso_three_apply identity, which reassociates the factors by Iso.trans_assoc and applies functoriality of mapIso without unfolding the affine objects. The first two factors followed by affineRepresentativeStalkIso are affineTildeHomologyLocalization. Naturality of affineRepresentativeStalkIso for delta inverse gives the homology square. Apply homologyMap_comp to tau followed by tensorStalkIso, cancel tensorStalkIso inverse, and compose the resulting pointwise equalities to obtain the displayed coordinate equation.

theorem exists_affineOrdinaryTensorStalkCoordinates
    (R A R' A' : Type u) [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing R'] [CommRing A']
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra (A ⊗[R] R') A']
    (φg' : A →+* A') (φf' : R' →+* A')
    (hφg' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] R')) = φg')
    (hφf' : (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] R') A').comp
      Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom = φf')
    (sq : IsPullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf'))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A)))
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))))
    (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ)
    (i : ℤ) :
    let P := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
      (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace))
          (tilde.functor (.of A))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj M)
    let T := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback
      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg'))).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let C := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars φg').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj M
    (p : PrimeSpectrum A') →
      let f := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R A))
      let f' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φf')
      let g := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap R R'))
      let g' := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φg')
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.leftAlgebra f g' p
      letI := SingleComplexBaseChange.rightAlgebra f f' g g' sq p
      letI := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).toAlgebra
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p))
      letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u} (SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      let N := ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex _ _ _ _ _ _ _
        (@id (ModuleCat.{u} A' ⥤
          SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace))
            (tilde.functor (.of A'))) ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj C)
      let s := RingedSpace.moduleStalkFunctor (Spec (.of A')).toRingedSpace p
      let ρ := (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorMap f f' g g' sq p).comp
        (algebraMap (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p)
          (SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p ⊗[SingleComplexBaseChange.R f g' p]
            SingleComplexBaseChange.B f' p))
      ∃ τ : (s.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj N ≅
          SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorComplex f f' g g' sq p P,
        (∀ (j : ℤ) (x : M.X j),
          τ.hom.f j (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (N.X j).val.presheaf ⊤ p trivial
            (tilde.toOpen (R := .of A') (C.X j) ⊤ ((1 : A') ⊗ₜ[A, φg'] x))) =
            (1 : (Spec (.of A')).presheaf.stalk p) ⊗ₜ[SingleComplexBaseChange.A g' p, ρ]
              (TopCat.Presheaf.germ (P.X j).val.presheaf ⊤ (g' p) trivial
                (tilde.toOpen (R := .of A) (M.X j) ⊤ x))) ∧
        ∀ y, affineTensorPullbackHomologyStalkIso A A' φg' M p i y =
          (affineRepresentativeStalkIso (Spec (.of A')) p T i).inv
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
              (SingleComplexBaseChange.tensorStalkIso f f' g g' sq p P).hom i
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap τ.hom i
                  (affineTildeHomologyLocalization A' C p i y)))
